page.layout: One page of text. Verse block at the top with line numbers 35 to 40 in the right margin. Below it, a signature line set right. Then a centred heading with a verse psalm below. A catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: His oculis, his, inquam, oculis, vidi ipse ferocem 35 In morem viridis sese diffundere palmae. Vidi atq; obstupui: sed mox dum lumina verto, 36 Respiciocq; virum, (dictu mirabile,) tantus Iampridem tumor in tenues evaserat auras, Nec corpus, nec erant vestigia corporis usquam. At iustum si nosse cupis bene: respice finem. 37 Nam licet hic misere pressus gemat, attamen omnes Quos tulit excipiet tandem pars firma labores. At quibus impietas cordi est, scelerumq; libido, 38 Horrendo simul exitio cum stirpe peribunt. Namq; salus iusti Deus est, & robur, ubi ingens 39 Tempestas movet horrendos adversa tumultus, Tum vero auxiliator adest, & ab hoste superbo 40 Eripit, incolumesq; suos per secula servat.
main_text.head: PSALMVS XXXVII, carmine Sapphico conversus.
main_text.p: INsolens rebus nimium secundis Si tibi afflicto toleranda turba est, Inuidum non te faciat, nec armet Liuor in iram.

page.notes: The verse line numbers 35 to 40 are printed in the right margin and are given as notes. The "Nam" at the foot right is a catchword. The "s" long s is rendered as s throughout. The printed page number 365 stands at the head. No running head is printed. The signature "Ioannes Sanderus Saxo L." is set right-aligned and is given as a paragraph, not a heading.
